prompt: Write a short retirement speech about a coworker named Andrea that's retiring after 24 years of service as a staff member working at Rutgers University.
response: Andrea, you've been a stalwart at Rutgers for 24 years, and your dedication is unmatched. You've seen the university grow and change, but through it all, you've remained a constant. Your wisdom and experience will be sorely missed. Congratulations on your well-deserved retirement!
